task.title: Read the current key without counting every task
task.description:
Follow-up from the review of "Use active project task ID in sidebar rail" (PR #178, 2026-10-11). The desktop now re-reads every project's current key on window focus, board start, project open and in-app key changes, by running `workbook key list --json` once per project, all in parallel. key list also reports how many tasks each key minted (internal/cli/key.go runKeyList -> service.List + keyTaskCensus), which reads every task from the projection (refreshing it first if refs moved); the current key alone comes from the configuration ledger (LoadVocabularyState) and needs none of that. About 0.19s on this repository, growing with task count, times the number of projects, on every alt-tab.

Decided with Dylan: add `workbook key list --no-counts`: the same result with the per-key task counts left out (the JSON shape omits `tasks`, as the mutating key verbs already do), skipping the projection entirely. Switch the desktop's key refresh (desktop/src/main/projectkeys.js currentKey) to it, and cap how many key reads run at once (and consider a short cooldown for focus bursts).
